Overview
HIV
 remains a major public health challenge, especially in low- and 
middle-income countries. Inconsistent or delayed implementation of 
evidence-based interventions - compounded by workforce shortages, weak 
supply chains and poor service integration - continues to drive 
transmission, advanced disease and preventable deaths.
These
 guidelines consolidate WHO's evidence-based HIV service delivery 
recommendations issued from 2013 to 2025, supporting more 
people-centred, integrated and equitable service delivery. The goal is 
to improve access, strengthen continuity of care and accelerate progress
 toward ending AIDS as a public health threat.
